newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk c.bank keeps up heavy funding amid shortage.
newsitem.headline: Turk c.bank keeps up heavy funding amid shortage.

text.p: 1425 GMT - Turkey's 120 trln lira of mid-month public sector salary payments squeezed the mkt. The avrg o/n money rate edged up to 71.88 pct vs Wednesday's 71.11. * The c. bank lent 18.8 trln lira at 72 pct o/n, 45 trln lira via t/n and 21.8 trln lira via t/w. * Bond yields firmed to 100.80-95 pct levels from previous 99.70-100.33 pct in line with tight liquidity. * Lira firmed to 136,950 lira per dollar vs 137,390 on lower dollar/mark parity.
